THRE.description: Time History Analysis Results - Element Force (THRE). TYPE_ELEMENT (0:Beam, 1:Truss, 2:Wall) selects the element category; PROPERTY_KEY identifies the element and LOCATION/COMP select the result location and component, while STORY_NAME applies only to Wall elements.

THIS_NAME.description: Name of the Time History Load Case whose element-force results are graphed.

TYPE_ELEMENT.description: Type of Element. 0:Beam, 1:Truss, 2:Wall. Hard-validated against the element type of PROPERTY_KEY: 0 requires a beam element, 1 requires a truss element.

PROPERTY_KEY.description: Element identifier. For TYPE_ELEMENT 0 (Beam) and 1 (Truss) this is the element number; for TYPE_ELEMENT 2 (Wall) this is the User Wall ID. Must reference an existing element.

STORY_NAME.description: [TYPE_ELEMENT=2 Wall] Name of the Story. Used only when TYPE_ELEMENT is 2 (Wall); ignored otherwise.

COMP.description: Force component. 0:Axial (Fx), 1:Shear-y (Fy), 2:Shear-z (Fz), 3:Torsion (Mx), 4:Moment-y (My), 5:Moment-z (Mz). For TYPE_ELEMENT=1 (Truss) COMP must be 0 (hard-validated).
